name: Compact
description: Contributes the CompactContext tool: queue a context compaction (checkpoint + prune) through the host's context:compact seam. Two triggers: manual (the user asks to compact, or routes /compact to the model) and auto (the model calls the tool itself when the session feels context-heavy). The plugin never compacts directly; it validates args and queues the request, and the host performs the rewrite after the turn.

tool.name: CompactContext
tool.description: Queue a context compaction: the host checkpoints the conversation (summary or verbatim tail) and prunes older history. MANUAL trigger: call when the user asks to compact, clean up, or shorten context. AUTO trigger: call proactively when context feels heavy (high context % in SessionInfo, very long history, degrading recall) even without being asked. Args: mode (tail|local|remote|fork, default local), tail (trailing messages kept verbatim, default 6), focus (hint kept verbatim in the checkpoint), reason (manual|auto, default auto). Returns queued:true when the host accepted the request; the rewrite happens after this turn, so continue with the retained tail.

mode.description: Compaction engine. tail keeps the last N messages verbatim (instant, no summary). local writes a checkpoint summary plus tail. remote uses the provider compact endpoint with local fallback. fork checkpoints for a sub-agent handoff.

tail.description: Trailing messages kept verbatim behind the checkpoint. Default 6.

focus.description: Hint passed to the summarizer and kept verbatim in the checkpoint (e.g. what the next step needs).

reason.description: Why compacting: manual (the user asked) or auto (the model decided). Default auto.
